name: agent-evals-platform
description: Evaluate Hermes Agent configurations (model, skills, memory, tools) with statistically grounded comparisons.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @agent-evals/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,green "npm:dev -w @agent-evals/shared" "npm:dev -w @agent-evals/api" "npm:dev -w @agent-evals/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @agent-evals/shared && npm run build -w @agent-evals/api && npm run build -w @agent-evals/web
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
